        cat = parts[1].strip().lower()
        raw_amount = parts[2].strip()
        
        if not raw_amount:
            continue

        # Handle parenthesized negatives
        is_negative = False
        if raw_amount.startswith('(') and raw_amount.endswith(')'):
            is_negative = True
            raw_amount = raw_amount[1:-1]

        # Remove currency symbols and thousands separators
        raw_amount = raw_amount.replace('$', '').replace(',', '')
        
        try:
            amount = float(raw_amount)
            if is_negative:

            totals[cat] = totals.get(cat, 0) + amount
        except ValueError:
